faqs.question: What are your business working hours and locations?
faqs.answer: Our head office is located in Bahawalpur, Pakistan. Office hours are Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM PKT. Our WhatsApp AI Bot is available 24/7!

faqs.question: How do I book a consultation or demo?
faqs.answer: You can request an appointment directly in this WhatsApp chat by specifying your preferred date and time (e.g., 'Book a demo tomorrow at 3 PM'). The bot will schedule it into our Google Calendar automatically.

faqs.question: What is your refund and cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Appointments can be rescheduled or cancelled up to 4 hours in advance without any fee. Service setup fees have a 7-day money-back guarantee in Rupees (Rs) if setup fails.

faqs.question: What currency do you accept for payment in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: All prices are in Pakistani Rupees (Rs / PKR). Payments can be made via direct Bank Transfer (HBL/Meezan), JazzCash, or EasyPaisa.

faqs.question: Do you support custom AI model integrations?
faqs.answer: Yes, we support Groq (openai/gpt-oss-20b), Google Gemini, OpenAI GPT-4o, and self-hosted open-source models.
